note: evidence: the sibling norm-linear cases realize the same mma tier with the norm on the A side; with the norm on the WEIGHT the contraction takes the computed-B smem compute fill, whose cone re-binds the contraction axis name for its own sum-of-squares statistic. Guards the fill's hygienic σ: a blind substitution rewired that nested reduce onto the slab coordinate, summing one element 128 times (wrong answer, not a refusal).

attrs.body:
in0 = load rms_norm_eps[0]
in1 = load rms_norm_mean_count[0]
for a0 in 0..64:
    for a1 in 0..64:
        for a2 in 0..128:
            in2 = load x1[a1, a2]
            v0 = multiply(in2, in2)
            acc0 <- add(acc0, v0) over a2
        v1 = divide(acc0, in1)
        v2 = add(in0, v1)
        v3 = rsqrt(v2)
        for a2 in 0..128:
            in3 = load x0[a0, a2]
            in4 = load x1[a1, a2]
            v4 = multiply(in4, v3)
            in5 = load x2[a2]
            v5 = multiply(in5, v4)
            f32 v6 = multiply(in3, v5)
            acc1 <- add(acc1, v6) over a2
        linear[a0, a1] = acc1
